description: The story runner's reply for one Jira ticket. Field meanings are in runner-prompt.md.

reason.description: Why the ticket was not drafted, addressed to the requester. Empty when drafted.

suggested_title.description: Story title from story-rules 2a. Posted as a suggestion only.

story_markdown.description: Story sections from ### Background to ### Open Questions.

analysis_markdown.description: Abstract Task, INVEST Evaluation and any Split Strategy.

labels.description: Up to three theme labels taken from the recent stories.

notes_for_reviewer.description: Anything the reviewer should know that doesn't belong in the story. Empty if nothing.
